case_number: 2025 INSC 15; Civil Appeal No. of 2025 (@ SLP (C) No. 30491 of 2018)
summary: Motor accident compensation; insurer appeals against enhancement by High Court; personal expense deduction: one-third standard applies; income assessment upheld despite lack of documentary proof; reliance on Sarla Verma for objective estimation; conventional heads capped at Rs.70,000 with triennial 10% update; Pranay Sethi benchmark applied; appeals by insurer dismissed; enhancement sustained.
legal_provisions_cited: Sarla Verma v. Delhi Transport Corporation
National Insurance Co. Ltd v. Pranay Sethi & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeals by insurer dismissed; compensation enhancement granted by High Court upheld.
